# freshdesk_products (Data Source)

Every product on the helpdesk. Products are managed in the admin console rather than through the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_products" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source. Always `products`.
- `products` (Attributes List) Every product the API returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products))

<a id="nestedatt--products"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the product was created (RFC 3339).
- `default` (Boolean) Whether new tickets fall back to this product.
- `description` (String) Description of the product.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the product.
- `name` (String) Name of the product.
- `primary_email` (String) Support address for the product.
- `updated_at` (String) When the product was last changed (RFC 3339).
